name: identity_music_beds_list
title: List identity music beds
description: App-only Brand/Music Studio library read. Returns a terse index of account-owned music beds (plus global samples): title, generation prompt, provider, duration, kind, and readiness — enough to choose a bed by its described vibe without listening. Deep metadata/provenance stays on single-bed payloads. identity_assets_list lists beds alongside openers, outros, and project defaults; identity_apply_to_project makes a song the default full-Episode cue on future reels; music_cue_mutate scores an existing Episode. Without project_id it reads the account-level library (Music Studio).

project_id.description: Project public ID; absent for the account library.
